notes.title: Once Upon a Jester works great on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
The misadventures of Jester and Sok are now perfectly playable and very much enjoyable on Steam Deck and Steam compatible devices!

That's right! Now you can grab Once Upon a Jester, stick 'em in your pocket and create mischief together while commuting, doing garden work or on long, remote hikes. The possibilities are endless!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40785394/4a5837f897d0907a918aec6773b85086a6ef8cee.jpg[/img]

[*] Works in smooth 60fps in "High" graphics preset.
[*] Uses xbox glyphs, so we're good and there's no confusion about pressing the triangle button
[*] Controls work just fine
[*] UI scaling? You're damn right 
[*] Runs in default 720p 
[/list]

notes.title: 🎉 We won "Best Narrative" at Gamescom LATAM Big Festival! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re beyond excited to share some amazing news with you all – Once Upon a Jester has won the Best Narrative award at the Gamescom LATAM Big Festival! 🎭✨

This recognition means the world to us, especially since it’s been a journey built on your support, creativity, and love for our quirky storytelling. We couldn't have done it without you, and we’re incredibly grateful for our amazing community! 🧡

If you haven’t yet, come experience the wild, whimsical adventure of Sok and Jester—now an award-winning narrative! 🏆

Stay connected with us on social media for more updates, behind-the-scenes fun, and much more:

🐦 [url=https://x.com/BonteAvond]Bonte Avond Twitter[/url]
🐦 [url=https://x.com/CrunchingKoalas]Crunching Koalas Twitter[/url]


Thank you for all the love and support. Here’s to more adventures!

notes.title: We're nominated for awards at Gamescom LATAM's BIG Festival
notes.notes:
Once Upon a Jester has been nominated for awards in the following categories at the BIG Festival, taking place during Latino American edition of Gamescom:

We're thrilled to be nominated among other great titles - you can find the whole list of nominees here: [url=https://latam.gamescom.global/en/big-festival-en/#finalists]https://latam.gamescom.global/en/big-festival-en/#finalists

notes.notes:

Don't believe us? Here's proof (around the 24:27 mark): 
[previewyoutube=eH67as6A7Og;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Once Upon a Jester is a finalist of Independent Game Festival!
notes.notes:
The Independent Game Festival competition awards winners in eight categories during GDC in March, and [b]we're excited to be listed among the forerunners for the award.[/b]

The ceremony will be held on [u]March 20th[/u], during this year's edition of GDC (Game Developer Conference), [u]from 6:30 PM to 7:30 PM PST[/u]. 

We're proud to stand among other exceptional titles like goodbye.monster, Pile Up!, Planetka, RAM: Random Access Mayhem and TRY AGAIN. Best of luck to all of them!

If you'd like to see if we won, keep an eye out on these twitter accounts:

notes.title: Sun's shining and our games are on huge discounts. Yep, must be the Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
It's that time of the year again, where Lord Gaben (long may He reign) blesses us with discounts and sales. 

To make it easier for everyone to find great games worth their hard-earned money, we're throwing our titles into the ring!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34046344/2db2e49c791d9f436cef4e8d389847bb0b87b90d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Want to tease your brain and solve some puzzles? [b]MouseCraft is for you![/b]
[*] Feel like doing some wacky construction in space with your friends? [b]Bonkies is perfect![/b]
[*] Your funny bone requires tickling? [b]Once Upon a Jester will do just that![/b]
[*] Want to shoot spears made of pure light at weird creatures? [b]Lichtspeer's got your back![/b]
[/list]

See? [u]There's something for everyone![/u]

And while you're here, you can also check out our upcoming titles:

[b]Techno Banter[/b] - an adventure game about being a bouncer guarding the entrance to a techno club. If you think you've got wits and humour to chase the unwanted guests away, test your mettle here!

[b]The Gap[/b] - a serious, narrative story about a man fighting to save his own sanity and his family, while delving ever deeper into his past.

If those games pique your interest, it would mean a lot to us if you wishlisted!

Have a great Summer Sale, and may Lord Gaben have mercy on our wallets.

notes.title: We have a new demo and a new trailer!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We are very glad to announce that Once Upon a Jester was hand-picked to feature in Future Games Show's exciting Virtual Show Floor section. It highlights the most interesting upcoming indie titles and invites viewers to come play the new demos! We are honored to be among other great titles!

But that's not the end of great news - [b]Once Upon a Jester will be released later this year![/b]

We're working on it with our new publisher - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/CrunchingKoalas]Crunching Koalas[/url] - known mostly for the console releases of Darkwood, Project Warlock and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/474210/BUTCHER/]BUTCHER[/url]! To celebrate this moment, we would like to show you our new trailer:
